extract_file_from_zip: extract a single file from a zip archive to a specified directory using extract_file
run_energy_extraction: run the script to extract final potential energies from VASP relaxation trajectories in parallel
process_vasp_trajectories: process VASP vasprun.xml files to extract final potential energy values using ASE
refactor_process_func: refactor process_func to support additional trajectory formats beyond VASP XML
summarize_get_energies: summarize the get_energies module which extracts potential energies from DFT relaxation outputs
